newsitem.title: USA: John Alden Financial Corp Q1 net share falls.
newsitem.headline: John Alden Financial Corp Q1 net share falls.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTES: In 1996 the company's board authorized the sale of the company's annuity operations and its Western Diversified Group.

Net income includes profits of $0.31 a share in Q1 1997 and $0.33 a share in Q1 1996 from these discontinued operations and also includes severance and other restructuring actions related to continuing operations of $0.59 a share in Q1 1997 and $0.17 a share in Q1 1996.
Excluding severance and restructuring, but including profits from discontinued operations, Q1 1997 operating earnings were $1.00 per share and Q1 1996 operating earnings were $0.71 a share.
